MA H2501 — Massachusetts Aims to Tackle LGBTQ+ Health Gaps

Massachusetts is taking a new step to address health disparities faced by LGBTQ+ individuals. This bill directs state agencies – including Health and Human Services, Education, and Transportation – to actively collect voluntary data on sexual orientation and gender identity. ...
